in_hebrew.name: עַרְדָּר
in_hebrew.long_meaning: עַרְדָּר (Ardar) - שֵם שֶׁמֵּאין יְדַע - זֶה שֵם חָסוֹם שֶׁמְצוּץ בִּתְקוֹפוֹת קְדוֹמוֹת. מֵאֵין הָאֲזָחֲלָה, וְלֹא יָדַעְתִּי. (Job 31:6) בִּתְקוֹפוֹת נָבוֹא, וְלֹא תֹאבַד, (Proverbs 10:25) זִכְרוֹן ה' יִהְיֶה תָּמִיד. (Isaiah 26:3)

in_greek.name: Άρδρα
in_greek.long_meaning: Άρδρα (Ardra) - ὄνομα ὃ οὐκ ἔχει νοῦν - τούτο ὄνομα ἀπωλεία ὃ ἐν τοῖς παλαιοῖς χρῶνται. οὐκ ἔχον ἡ ἀρχή, καὶ οὐκ ἔγνων. (Ἰωβ 31:6) ἐν τοῖς μελλομένοις ἐλεύσομαι, καὶ οὐκ ἀπολοῦμαι, (Πρβ 10:25) ἡ μνήμη τοῦ Κυρίου ἔσται ἀεὶ τὸ αὐτό. (Ἠσαΐας 26:3)

in_latin.name: Ardra
in_latin.long_meaning: Ardra - nomen quod non habet intellectum - hoc nomen exitium quod in antiquis usi sunt. non habet principium, et non novi. (Iob 31:6) in futuris veniam, et non peribit, (Proverbiorum 10:25) memoria Domini semper perseverabit. (Isaiah 26:3)

in_english.name: Ardra
in_english.meaning: name that holds no understanding or intellect
in_english.long_meaning: Ardra - a name that signifies destruction and has been used in ancient times. It lacks a beginning and is unknown. (Job 31:6) In the future, it shall come and shall not perish, (Proverbs 10:25) the memory of the Lord shall remain forever. (Isaiah 26:3) This name holds a deep spiritual significance and is associated with the concept of nothingness and the void.

pronunciation.biblical: Ardra (Hebrew: עַרְדָּר), pronounced /ʕardar/ in biblical Hebrew

biblical_reference.note: Ardra is mentioned in the book of Job, chapter 31, verse 6, as a name that signifies destruction and lack of understanding.

data.cultural_impact: The original meaning and significance of the name Ardra were rooted in ancient Indian cultures. Ardra was the goddess of mountains and fertility, who was believed to bring abundant harvests and prosperity. Her presence was invoked during agricultural festivals, symbols of her power and protection being depicted in various forms of art and artifacts.
data.spiritual_significance: In Christianity, however, the name Ardra holds a different and more significant meaning. It is believed that 'Ardra', as a Christian name, represents a person who is steadfast in their faith, just like the mountains that endure and remain undeterred through all trials and tribulations. The name suggests strength, perseverance, and unwavering commitment to the teachings and values of Christianity. It's a reminder that character, like a mountain, is unchanging and steadfast, and that one should strive to embody such godly attributes in their daily lives.
